title: Base change of finite etale covers and the map of fundamental groups
statement:
Let $f:Y'\to Y$ be a morphism of connected schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\bar y'$ be a geometric point of $Y'$ and $\bar y=f\circ\bar y'$, the corresponding geometric point of $Y$. Write $\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$, $\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y')$ and $|P_{\bar y}|$ as in [def-galois-categories], and $\pi_1(Y,\bar y)$, $\pi_1(Y',\bar y')$ for the profinite groups of [def-galois-fibre-functor], acting on $|P_{\bar y}|$, $|Q_{\bar y'}|$ through the fibre functors. Base change $f^*:\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)\to\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y')$, $P\mapsto P\times_YY'$ (with its second projection), is a functor, and for $P\in\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$ the map
$$
\tau_P:|(P\times_YY')_{\bar y'}|\longrightarrow|P_{\bar y}|,\qquad z\longmapsto \mathrm{pr}_1\circ z,
$$
is a bijection, natural in $P$. There is a continuous group homomorphism
$$
f_*:\pi_1(Y',\bar y')\longrightarrow\pi_1(Y,\bar y)
$$
such that $f_*(g)\cdot\tau_P(z)=\tau_P(g\cdot z)$ for all $g\in\pi_1(Y',\bar y')$, $P\in\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$ and $z\in|(P\times_YY')_{\bar y'}|$. In other words, under $\tau$ the finite $\pi_1(Y',\bar y')$-set $|(f^*P)_{\bar y'}|$ is the finite $\pi_1(Y,\bar y)$-set $|P_{\bar y}|$ with $\pi_1(Y',\bar y')$ acting through $f_*$, naturally in $P$.
